title: Informative distinction between naming and visible guidance
change_reason: Original source-grounded pilot draft; human review pending.
observation: The explanation distinguishes an accessible name from labels or instructions available to all users; assistive-technology-only naming may leave this criterion unmet.
interpretation: Inspect the rendered form as well as its accessibility properties.
scope: Informative explanation of input guidance under SC 3.3.2.
method: Manual inspection of the linked official document and the named section; original paraphrase, no empirical user test.
limitations: A screen-reader name alone does not settle whether the visible input guidance is sufficient.
Same W3C origin; no separate empirical finding.
